welcome.title: Learn With Clarity
welcome.content: This page brings together everything you need to move through the lesson: video, activities, questions, and support from SofLIA.

header.title: Course Header
header.content: Here you can see the course name, go back to the previous screen, and restart this tour whenever you need it.

progress.title: Your Progress
progress.content: This indicator summarizes your course progress so you always know how much you have completed.

sidebar.title: Course Content
sidebar.content: Use this panel to move through modules, lessons, materials, and notes without leaving the learning experience.

moduleProgress.title: Module Progress
moduleProgress.content: These labels show how many lessons you have completed in the module and the percentage reached.

currentLesson.title: Current Lesson
currentLesson.content: The highlighted lesson marks where you are. You can switch topics from the list whenever you want to continue elsewhere.

tabs.title: Work Modes
tabs.content: Switch between video, activities, and questions depending on what you want to do right now.

video.title: Lesson Video
video.content: Play the main content, control your progress, and use the built-in navigation to move between lessons.

resources.title: Transcript and Summary
resources.content: Review the full text or the lesson summary and turn them into notes for later study.

activitiesTab.title: Activities
activitiesTab.content: Open this tab to practice what you learned, review materials, and complete exercises when they are available.

activities.title: Guided Practice
activities.content: This section shows the lesson activities and supporting materials. If there is no content yet, you will see the matching empty state.

questionsTab.title: Questions
questionsTab.content: Open this area to review course questions or start a conversation with other participants.

questions.title: Course Conversations
questions.content: Search existing questions or create a new one to resolve doubts about the lesson.

sofliaPanel.title: SofLIA Panel
sofliaPanel.content: When SofLIA is open, this is where suggestions, answers, and the lesson question field appear.

soflia.title: Your SofLIA Assistant
soflia.content: SofLIA helps you clarify concepts, generate notes, and connect the content with your course progress.

welcome.title: Welcome to your panel
welcome.content: Here you can find your learning paths, assigned courses, and key shortcuts to keep learning.

topNav.title: Top Bar
topNav.content: This area confirms the active organization and keeps your main panel shortcuts close at hand.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.content: Check updates about courses, activities, and important changes so you can stay on track.

accountMenu.title: Your Account
accountMenu.content: Open your profile, statistics, certificates, language, and other personal options from here.

hero.title: Panel Overview
hero.content: The greeting places you in your learning space and summarizes the purpose of this view.

coursesHeader.title: Your Courses
coursesHeader.content: This section brings together learning paths and standalone courses assigned to your account.

viewToggle.title: Course View
viewToggle.content: Switch between grid and list view to review your courses in the format that works best for you.

learningPath.title: Learning Path
learningPath.content: Paths organize courses by priority. Complete each step to unlock or continue the next one.

introVideo.title: Intro Video
introVideo.content: Play this video to understand the goal of the path before you start or continue.

courseRail.title: Course Carousel
courseRail.content: Move through the path to see available, locked, and completed courses in order.

courseCard.title: Course Card
courseCard.content: Each card shows the cover, progress, status, and entry point for the course content.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.content: When you complete a course with a certificate, this shortcut lets you open it quickly.

standalone.title: Standalone Courses
standalone.content: Courses assigned outside a path appear here with their own progress and status.

soflia.title: Your SofLIA Assistant
soflia.content: SofLIA can help with questions about your courses, progress, or next steps whenever you need it.

welcome.title: Business Panel
welcome.content: This panel brings together your organization's overall status, key shortcuts, and recent team activity.

topNav.title: Top Bar
topNav.content: Confirm the active organization here and quickly reach notifications and account options.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.content: Review important updates about users, courses, and follow-up events across your organization.

accountMenu.title: Account Menu
accountMenu.content: Use your avatar to switch panels, edit your profile, adjust language, review certificates, or sign out.

sidebar.title: Side Navigation
sidebar.content: Use this menu to move through users, courses, paths, structure, reports, reviews, and settings.

sidebarCollapse.title: Adjust Menu
sidebarCollapse.content: Collapse or expand the sidebar to gain workspace without losing the main navigation.

hero.title: Opening Summary
hero.content: The header gives you panel context, greets the administrator, and shows the current work date.

relaunch.title: Guided Tour
relaunch.content: Use this button to relaunch the panel walkthrough whenever you need to locate its main functions.

stats.title: General Metrics
stats.content: These cards show active users, assigned courses, completions, progress, certificates, engagement, and invitations.

quickActions.title: Quick Actions
quickActions.content: Jump straight into frequent tasks such as managing users, assigning courses, opening reports, or configuring the organization.

recentActivity.title: Recent Activity
recentActivity.content: Check the latest team movements to spot progress, changes, or relevant pending work.

soflia.title: Your SofLIA Assistant
soflia.content: SofLIA can support you with panel questions, courses, team progress, or next management steps.
